result.markdown:
For a small company, I'd recommend **BambooHR as the best all-round HR platform**, but the right choice depends on whether you mainly need employee management, payroll, compliance, or recruitment.

Here are the five platforms I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best HR software for small businesses

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. BambooHR**

(Best overall)

- Employee records and documentation
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Leave and absence management
- Performance reviews and reporting

Best for companies wanting a proper HR management system.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![Employment Hero revenue, funding & news | Sacra](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fzjrXPaeDGwbU0ktEn3_TQOhXXDHf36IZVXODrp9T7HoPtffJn3log8dcNXgqmxNTVoSA7Z8uruA7pqFNxyUEhGcStTX98s15F3_UqZVdwX3Hil0ScIjHbsYgq5CRV83FbCLkZXcqjEJTHBYwixjaLt2P4LznFNYwuYqYTuorQs3fGdTLjy3xRq6ouhsJUWG?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Employment Hero**

(Best for Australian businesses)

- Australian employment-focused HR tools
- Employee onboarding
- Rostering and time tracking
- Payroll and leave management

Particularly worth considering if you're operating in Australia.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation)

- HR and employee management
- Payroll capabilities
- IT and software access management
- Automated employee workflows

Great for a growing company wanting to automate administration.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

- Employee database
- Leave management
- Attendance tracking
- Performance management

Good for smaller businesses wanting affordable HR software.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![HiBob Company Profile – Israel Office | Secret Tel Aviv](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VqtrRaPcgUicXO-4Ys0LiaPCrKe-5CJsa6TkSYgK1KcefpQhkEpEHerjMriA1N5YlEChNgmd7rQjSw27yQX48bFCzMJuRS79dEcVkcuDFBzyX6mwJYyF0haiasPADaDYIeAoykjLgSELovlBtSVFVxZrjW7VMjyk6qPW9KpNiwrWMbEgzHfDR3XQ7fQVHM0g?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. HiBob**

- Employee engagement
- Performance management
- People analytics
- Employee lifecycle management

Best for companies investing in culture, engagement and people development.

[HiBob website](https://www.hibob.com/)

## My comparison

| Software | Main strength | Best suited to |
|--------|--------|--------|
| BambooHR | Complete HR management | 10–200 employees |
| Employment Hero | Australian HR and payroll | Australian SMEs |
| Rippling | Automation and integrations | Fast-growing companies |
| Zoho People | Affordability | 1–50 employees |
| HiBob | Engagement and performance | Growing teams |


These are indicative fits rather than hard employee limits. The choice also depends on payroll requirements and integrations. The broader 2026 comparisons similarly highlight BambooHR for core HR, Rippling for automation and Zoho for affordability.
